summary: Compugen Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 financial results and corporate update. No special-situation event is present; the filing reports routine earnings, clinical trial progress (COM701 MAIA-ovarian trial), and partnership updates with AstraZeneca and Gilead. The company has $134.9M cash, no debt, and expects cash runway into 2029. Net loss was ~$2.9M for Q1 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing is a standard earnings report by a foreign private issuer.
